nodes.plm_caption:
A person in a t-shirt stands in a kitchen, facing the camera. He shows a bowl of cooked brussels sprouts and then proceeds to show various ingredients and tools used to prepare the dish.
In the beginning of the video, various ingredients and tools are shown lined up on the counter, to the right of a kitchen appliance. As the man starts to demonstrate how to prepare the dish, he holds one of the ingredients in a zip lock bag and points to the knife on the cutting board. He moves to an electric pressure cooker and points to a bottle of oil that is next to it. He then moves to a glass measuring cup and picks up a bag full of brussels sprouts.
As the man moves on to the next steps of the recipe, he holds up a zip lock bag of brussels sprouts, then pours out salt and pepper into the bag, then pours out a cup of oil.
At 3s, the man moves to the cutting board and uses a knife to cut the brussels sprouts. It takes him 4 seconds to prepare the tools, then he prepares the ingredients by pouring oil in a glass measuring cup, then adding salt and pepper to a zip lock bag, then pouring the bag of brussels sprouts in a black tray.

At 6s, the man pours the prepared ingredients on the tray and prepares the tray to move into the oven. He turns and opens the oven door at 6s.
At 7s, he removes the prepared tray of brussels sprouts and puts them on a white plate. He holds the plate and shows a nutrition information overlay of the dish.
At 13s, a man in a black t-shirt walks into frame and stands next to the other man.

The video ends with an ad for other videos on the person's youtube channel.

summary.brief: A host seasons halved Brussels sprouts, roasts them, displays the finished dish with nutrition info, and ends with channel promos.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the host, wearing a white T‑shirt, standing at a kitchen counter and pointing to a bowl of cooked Brussels sprouts and a lineup of ingredients. He preheats the oven to 400 °F, trims the ends off the sprouts, rinses them, and cuts each sprout in half on a cutting board. The halved sprouts are placed in a zip‑lock bag, a small amount of oil is added, and half‑teaspoons of garlic, pepper, and salt are poured in. He seals the bag, massages and shakes it to coat the sprouts evenly, then pours the seasoned sprouts onto a baking sheet, spreading them out so they are in a single layer. The sheet is slid into the pre‑heated oven and roasted for roughly 20–25 minutes, with a quick check at the 20‑minute mark. After the roasting time he removes the tray, lets the sprouts cool for a minute or two, and transfers them to a white plate. While he holds the plate, a nutrition‑information graphic appears beside the dish. A second man in a black T‑shirt then joins him for a brief conversation. The segment concludes with animated graphics displaying a clock, nutrition overlay, and promotional tiles for other Buff Dude recipes such as quinoa‑crust pizza and rice‑krispies.

action.detailed: Cut the Brussels sprouts in half, place them in a zip‑lock bag, add a little oil, garlic, pepper, and salt, seal and shake to coat, spread the seasoned sprouts on a baking sheet, roast at 400 °F for about 22 minutes, then remove and serve.
action.actor: the man in a white T‑shirt standing in the kitchen

summary.brief: Man seasons, roasts, and serves Brussels sprouts.
summary.detailed: In a home kitchen a bearded man first trims the ends off fresh Brussels sprouts, rinses them, and cuts each sprout in half on a cutting board. He transfers the halves to a zip‑lock bag, adds oil, garlic powder, pepper and salt, massages the bag and shakes it until the vegetables are evenly coated. He spreads the seasoned sprouts onto a baking sheet, places the sheet in a pre‑heated 400 °F oven, and roasts them for about 22 minutes, checking at the 20‑minute mark. After a brief cooling period he removes the tray, transfers the roasted sprouts to a board or plate, and tastes the finished dish.

* **Ingredients:**
	+ 1 1/2 lbs of Brussels Sprouts (approximately 4c. or 400g)
	+ 2 Tablespoons Avocado (or Olive) Oil
	+ 1/2 teaspoon Salt
	+ 1/2 teaspoon Pepper
	+ 1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder
* **Cooking Instructions:**
	+ Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
	+ Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
	+ Drizzle the avocado oil over the Brussels sprouts and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
	+ Toss the Brussels sprouts to coat them evenly with the seasonings.
	+ Roast the Brussels sprouts in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.
	+ Serve the roasted Brussels sprouts hot, garnished with additional salt and pepper if desired.

Overall, this recipe provides a simple and delicious way to prepare Brussels sprouts, with a focus on highlighting their natural sweetness and texture.

* 2 Tablespoons Avocado (or Olive) Oil
* 1/2 teaspoon Salt

* Drizzle the avocado oil over the Brussels sprouts and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
* Toss the Brussels sprouts to coat them evenly with the seasonings.
* Roast the Brussels sprouts in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.

summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with the host, wearing a white T‑shirt, standing at a kitchen counter and pointing to a bowl of cooked Brussels sprouts and a lineup of ingredients. He preheats the oven to 400 °F, trims the ends off the sprouts, rinses them, and cuts each sprout in half on a cutting board. The halved sprouts are placed in a zip‑lock bag, a small amount of oil is added, and half‑teaspoons of garlic, pepper, and salt are poured in. He seals the bag, massages and shakes it to coat the sprouts evenly, then pours the seasoned sprouts onto a baking sheet, spreading them out so they are in a single layer. The sheet is slid into the pre‑heated oven and roasted for roughly 20–25 minutes, with a quick check at the 20‑minute mark. After the roasting time he removes the tray, lets the sprouts cool for a minute or two, and transfers them to a white plate. While he holds the plate, a nutrition‑information graphic appears beside the dish. A second man in a black T‑shirt then joins him for a brief conversation. The segment concludes with animated graphics displaying a clock, nutrition overlay, and promotional tiles for other Buff Dude recipes such as quinoa‑crust pizza and rice‑krispies.
